on_failure.prompt: Destroy a frozen card in their arsenal or a frozen non-hero permanent they control?

_comment:
'When this hits a hero' = TRIGGERED ON_HIT gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (condition_types.py:1960-1977, no params; false when the attack was declared at a permanent/ally). Ability-level conditions are checked at resolution.

Release note followed: the pay choice belongs to the DEFENDING hero and is made when the triggered effect resolves - PAY_OR_ELSE with player OPPONENT (= the hit hero under this gate) asks pay/decline only if they hold >= 2 resources (effect_types.py:3247-3252); fewer resources skips the ask and runs on_failure, which is 'may pay' with an empty wallet. If they don't pay, MY destroy is optional ('you may ... or you may do nothing at all') - hence MAY wrapping DESTROY_MATCHING: declining runs nothing, and an empty pool also destroys nothing. on_failure effects resolve with player params relative to the same source card (effect_types.py:3210-3212), so the nested MAY prompts ME, the attacker.

DEVIATION FROM THE BATCH PRIMITIVES, disclosed: LOOK_AT(ARSENAL)+SELECT_FROM_REF+DESTROY_REF cannot express this - LOOK_AT's filter supports only keyword/subtype/face_down (effect_types.py:3394-3407), so 'frozen' is unfilterable there and the destroy would offer unfrozen arsenal cards too. DESTROY_MATCHING's object-target spec is the right tool: _compile_object_target (effect_types.py:675-804) takes controller/zones/amount/filter, pools ARSENAL+ARENA into ONE pick-one prompt (_ask_player), and applies ordinary condition specs per CANDIDATE. ARENA = player.permanents.cards (effect_types.py:463-464), which holds items/auras/allies/tokens and NOT the hero, so 'non-hero permanent' is automatic; reading note: 'permanent' taken to include every arena object that is not the hero, which is what the printed 'non-hero' qualifier is excluding.

The frozen predicate: the sibling triage note (.triage/conquer_the_icy_terrain_yellow.json) claims no per-candidate frozen condition exists - STALE. HAS_COUNTER (condition_types.py:1368-1380) reads counter/counter_type/kind and tests the candidate's own counters; discrete freezes write card.counters['__frozen__'] (effect_keywords.py:2511) and continuous freezes write card.counters['__frozen_while__'] = CONTINUOUS_FREEZE onto the frozen objects themselves (play.py:805, 848). OR threads the candidate through each arm (condition_types.py:1901-1915), so both freeze kinds qualify and nothing else does.
